items.joke: A man is smoking a cigarette and blowing smoke rings into the air. His girlfriend becomes irritated with the smoke and says "Can't you see the warning on the cigarette pack? Smoking is hazardous to your health!" to which the man replies, "I am a programmer.  We don't worry about warnings; we only worry about errors."

idiom.title: Turn a blind eye
idiom.glossZh: “视而不见” 或 “装作没看见”。
idiom.interpretationEn: This idiom originates from the story of British naval hero Admiral Horatio Nelson. In 1801, during a battle, Nelson received a signal from his commander to retreat. However, because Nelson was blind in one eye, he used his blind eye to look at the signal, effectively ignoring it and continuing the attack. He won the battle, and the phrase “Turn a blind eye” has come to mean deliberately ignoring certain facts or issues.
idiom.interpretationZh: 这个成语来源于英国海军英雄霍雷肖·纳尔逊上将的故事。在 1801 年，纳尔逊在一次战斗中接受指挥官的信号，让他撤退。然而，纳尔逊因为自己的一只眼睛是盲的，他把这个信号看作是一个借口，故意用盲眼看向信号，并继续进攻。最终他战斗成功，这个故事流传下来，就有了 “Turn a blind eye” 这个成语，表示故意忽视某些事实或问题。

examples.en: The manager decided to turn a blind eye to the minor rule-breaking.
examples.zh: 经理决定对小违规行为视而不见。

examples.en: She knows her son is lying, but she chooses to turn a blind eye.
examples.zh: 她知道儿子在撒谎，但她选择装作没看见。

examples.en: It’s hard to turn a blind eye to corruption in the government.
examples.zh: 很难对政府中的腐败现象视而不见。

people.name: Jan Bertels
people.extract: Jan Bertels is a Belgian politician and member of the Chamber of Representatives. A member of Vooruit, he has represented Antwerp since June 2024. He had previously been a member of the Chamber of Representatives from June 2019 to November 2020. He was a member of the Flemish Parliament from June 2014 to May 2019.
highlights: Belgian politician and member of the Chamber of Representatives.
Represented Antwerp in the Chamber since June 2024.
Previously served in the Flemish Parliament.

people.name: Alexander Berkman
people.extract: Alexander Berkman was a Russian-American anarchist and author. He was a leading member of the anarchist movement in the early 20th century, famous for both his political activism and his writing.
highlights: Leading member of early 20th century anarchist movement.
Famous for political activism and writing.

people.name: Evgeny Bareev
people.extract: Evgeny Ilgizovich Bareev is a Russian-Canadian chess player, trainer, and writer. Awarded the FIDE Grandmaster title in 1989, he was ranked fourth in the world in the international rankings in 1992 and again in 2003, with an Elo rating of 2739.
highlights: Russian-Canadian chess player, trainer, and writer.
Ranked fourth in the world in 1992 and 2003.
